title: Business Office Standard — Financial Hardship Decisions and Adjustments, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Decision.** A financial-hardship application on a Patient Financial Account is decided by the business office within the tier's hardship decision period, in business days, of a complete application. The decision is recorded on the account as a hardship-approved percentage and a hardship-approved-through date (the last date of service the approval covers; a denial records 0.00).

**Adjustment.** Each open charge whose date of service is on or before the hardship-approved-through date is then reduced by one adjustment coded as a hardship adjustment. The adjustment is the charge's remaining balance multiplied by the lower of the approved percentage and the tier's hardship adjustment maximum, rounded to the nearest cent. A charge's remaining balance is its amount less every time-of-service collection, payment and adjustment applied to it, plus the amount of any of those payments later reversed.

**Conditions for each charge.**

- The account's approved hardship percentage is above 0.00 and the charge's date of service is on or before the hardship-approved-through date, both as recorded on the account.
- A charge that already received the prompt-pay discount is excluded — the two are mutually exclusive on one charge — and a charge receives one hardship adjustment at most.
- A patient's own statement of hardship never substitutes for the recorded decision.

**Payment plans.** Charges enrolled in an active payment plan are adjusted too, and the plan's remaining balance is reduced by the same amount.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Recorded approval | Tier maximum | Charge remaining balance | Date of service vs approved-through | Hardship adjustment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 80.00% | 75.00% | 400.00 | on or before | 300.00 (75.00% of 400.00) |
| 50.00% | 100.00% | 123.40 | on or before | 61.70 (50.00% of 123.40) |
| 80.00% | 75.00% | 400.00 | after | none |
| 0.00% (denied) | 75.00% | 400.00 | on or before | none |
